name: Default
shortDescription: Report generator API that fills DOCX, XLSX, ODT and PPTX templates with JSON data and exports PDF and office formats, with the built-in Studio editor.

alerts.message: Studio asks for basic auth: the user is admin and the password is the part after the colon in CARBONE_STUDIO_USER. REST API calls need an ES512 JWT in the Authorization: Bearer header, signed with the key pair Carbone generates in /app/config on first start.
Without a license Carbone runs the free Community Edition features. Paste an Enterprise license into CARBONE_LICENSE to unlock the Enterprise features.
